reviews.frank_statement: EffectIntent and execution authority are distinct; protected effects require host-owned current authority rather than model/source text.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Database execution authority can safely be inferred from a textual resource name or ambient host APIs and needs no distinct runtime grant.
reviews.falsifier: An adversarial target-host run shows equivalent safety and utility when DB access is ambient/textual versus explicitly host-granted, including forged/stale resource cases.
independent_checks: New run-local executable discriminator: generated target with no injected DB adapter returned DENIED_NO_ADAPTER, while host-injected real SQLite adapter executed the same semantic IR.
adversarial_checks: Explicitly note unrestricted Python ambient-import escape remains untested and therefore blocks stronger claim
reviews.reason: The new mechanism test supports separating semantic DB intent from runtime DB resource possession, but it does not validate production confinement because the Python process is not a no-ambient-authority sandbox.
reviews.claycode_action: keep EffectIntent/resource-reference separate from runtime adapter authority; require a real sandbox/backend test before promotion

reviews.frank_statement: Semantic identity is distinct from physical placement/backend mechanics.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Concrete DB connection/transaction instance identity must be compiled into the program semantic identity for correct execution.
reviews.falsifier: Matched multi-backend execution demonstrates that correct semantics cannot be maintained unless runtime DB instance identity changes the canonical Clay semantic hash.
independent_checks: Run-local lowering kept one canonical semantic hash and deterministic generated target hash while concrete SQLite connection state was injected at runtime; CRUD/rollback semantics still matched the independent reference model in 500 fuzz cases.
adversarial_checks: Generated target scanned by construction to contain no sqlite import/path opening
reviews.reason: Single-backend local evidence supports identity separation, but cross-backend equivalence is still open; therefore this is not a general proof of placement independence.
reviews.claycode_action: preserve semantic/runtime-resource identity split and schedule matched second-backend differential
